edge_behavior.n=0: INVALID input (raises); status INSUFFICIENT_SIMULATIONS, never zero-filled
edge_behavior.p_hat=0: VALID zero simulation frequency, NOT missing; SE=0, Wilson=(0, upper>0)
edge_behavior.small_n: Wilson preferred over normal interval; normal intervals not blindly used at boundaries

implementation: v3.8c-consensus-metrics-v1 (mc_sampling_se, wilson_interval); REUSED UNCHANGED IN V3.9A

outcome_spread_distinction.A_sampling_uncertainty: How precisely did 5000 futures estimate this simulator frequency?
outcome_spread_distinction.B_outcome_spread: How varied were the simulator's generated outcomes?
outcome_spread_distinction.rule: NOT the same; broad spread with large n gives small SE. Frozen into contract.

quantities.n: valid futures only; refused/invalid excluded, never imputed
quantities.p_hat: k/n with n = valid MC2 futures
quantities.wilson_95: registered safer method; bounded, non-degenerate at p=0/1
